question: Could apparent spatial/taxonomic boundary recruitment be created by stop relocation rather than rainfall-associated acoustic change?
population: Exactly the frozen 4,236 NAAMP matched pairs.
physical_identity: Compare SiteID for the same StopNumber in wet and dry runs. A pair is physically stable only if all ten StopNumbers have nonmissing identical SiteID.
coordinates: Use pinned Coordinates.csv only to quantify displacement when SiteID changes.
sensitivity: Re-run the observed four-component allocation and primary kappa=2 uniform and a=.75 persistence nulls after excluding every pair with any SiteID mismatch/missingness.
pass_rule: >=95% pairs physically stable; stable subset observed boundary share >90%; both primary omnibus P<.05.
interpretation_boundary: This audits listening-station identity, not habitat constancy or causal hydrology.
